onboarding.guidelinesSubtitle: Please review these important guidelines for today's session
onboarding.rule1Desc: You must check in within the first 10 minutes of class. If you arrive late and the instructor has started the lesson, you'll see a "Lesson in Progress" message.
onboarding.rule2Desc: If you see the "Lesson in Progress" screen, you cannot join the current lesson block. You must wait until the next lesson starts to check in.
onboarding.rule3Desc: Once a lesson starts, students who haven't checked in are blocked from joining. This ensures all participants start together and prevents disruption.
onboarding.rule4Desc: If you're blocked from a lesson, you can rejoin when the instructor starts the next lesson. Make sure to check in promptly to avoid missing multiple lessons.
onboarding.rule5Desc: During lessons, you may receive random verification challenges (4-digit codes). You must enter the code displayed by your instructor to prove you're actively participating. This ensures you're paying attention and present in class.
onboarding.rule6Desc: When a challenge is issued, you'll hear an audio alert (if your browser is in fullscreen mode). This helps ensure you don't miss any challenges.
onboarding.rule7Desc: If you fail 2 challenges during a lesson, that lesson will be marked as incomplete. Your instructor has discretion to excuse failures for valid reasons (technical issues, emergency, etc.). Make sure to stay engaged!
onboarding.completeInfoBelow: Please complete your information and accept the terms below
onboarding.iAgreeTerms: I have read and agree to the Student Terms and Conditions
onboarding.headshotLighting: Ensure good lighting to clearly show your face.
onboarding.headshotNoAccessories: Avoid any accessories that might cover your face such as sunglasses or hats.
onboarding.headshotCentered: Your face should be centered and occupy most of the photo.
onboarding.idCardFlat: Place your ID card on a flat surface.
onboarding.idCardNoGlare: Avoid any glares on the card. Make sure all details are readable.
onboarding.idCardNameMatch: Ensure that the ID card's name matches the name registered for the course.
onboarding.validationNote: Uploading an ID card is a one-time requirement, but the headshot will be required daily for the 5-day class duration.
